title: SiriusXM Had Radio Locked Up. Spotify Ended That.
source: Spotify quarterly/annual reports (premium subscribers) and SiriusXM Holdings 10-K/10-Q filings (self-pay subscribers), as compiled by company earnings releases and industry press. Spotify: 28M (2015), 71M (2017), 124M (2019), 172M (2021), 226M (2023), 252M (2024). SiriusXM: 29M (2015), 32M (2017), 34.9M (2019), 34.5M (2021), 34.3M (2023), 33M (2024). Figures are approximate, rounded to the nearest whole/tenth million from reported quarterly figures.
